scope: IBM AT 286 VGA DOS=LOW: missing/truncated country boot fallback matches the default country/API table snapshot; selected runtime country failures preserve national state and recover; missing/malformed font preparation at every supported height preserves actual VGA glyph bytes and recovers. Opened invalid CPI files invalidate the prepared slot as documented. Every case requires guest-triggered emulator exit zero. This gate does not test physical input, rendered grids, installed paths, HIGH/UMB, later media-error rollback, or full release reproducibility.
